text: The Corvane E3 electric delivery van is rated at 290 kilometres of range, according to the company’s specification sheet filed with the National Transport Registry on Tuesday. In a note to fleet customers, Corvane said the figure was measured under its “urban mixed-load” test cycle, which assumes a 70 percent cargo load and moderate temperatures. The document, reviewed by The Continental Record, says the van’s battery pack is paired with regenerative braking software updated in May. Corvane chief engineer Lila Thorne said the E3 was designed for “predictable daily routes,” adding that pilot deliveries in Merrow and West Dain had met the advertised range in routine service.
